verified_note: Every law item was checked on 21.10.2026 against official sources (cyprus-private/tools-20261021/research/costs-rules.json): DLS fees leaflet, VAT Law 42(I)/2023, Stamp Duty repeal Law 239(I)/2025, Bank of Israel representative rate. Market items are published practitioner ranges and are labelled as such on the page. The joint-buyer split is described by Cyprus law firms, not by the DLS leaflet, and the page says so.

stamp_duty.note: Abolished for contracts signed from 1 January 2026 (Law 239(I)/2025).

fixed_fees.source: DLS fees leaflet: deposition of a contract of sale, EUR 50
